name: Crespos (Spain)
description: Purple field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Crespos (a castle on red, a tree on white and a lion).
history: The arms and the flag were approved by decree of the president of the Diputación Provincial de Ávila of 15 May 1995 (Boletín Oficial del Estado no. 139 of 12 June 1995); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, a purple cloth with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Crespos arms — castle, tree and lion
